L'esempio usa solo le regole della legge; le date di luglio 2026 non contengono giorni festivi di un intero Stato o territorio (ipotesi dichiarata nella pagina).

sezioni.titolo: The new deadline: 7 business days after payday
paragrafi: Every day on which you pay an employee qualifying earnings is a QE day. The contribution for that payday has to be received by the fund within the usual period, which starts on the QE day and ends on the seventh business day after it.[[payday_act]]

A business day is any day except a Saturday, a Sunday, or a day that is a public holiday for the whole of a state, the ACT or the Northern Territory.[[payday_act]] Regional holidays that do not cover a whole state do not stop the count.

A longer period, ending on the 20th business day after the QE day (the extended usual period), applies in some cases, for example to the first contribution to a fund for a new employee or after you stop paying into another fund.[[payday_act]]
Contributions received early also count: the Act lets a contribution received in the 12 months before the QE day be applied to it, so paying ahead of payday does not create a shortfall.[[payday_act]]

sezioni.titolo: What super is worked out on
paragrafi: The super guarantee is worked out on qualifying earnings: ordinary time earnings, commissions, payments to members of a company's board, payments for a person's labour under some contracts, and amounts an employee salary-sacrifices into super. The charge percentage is 12.[[payday_act]]

Ordinary time earnings are earnings for ordinary hours of work, including over-award payments, shift loading and commission, but not lump sums for unused sick, annual or long service leave paid on termination.[[payday_act]]

The Act rewrites the Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992 around the QE day instead of the quarter: it repeals the definition of the quarterly salary or wages base and replaces references to “a quarter that ended” with “a QE day”.[[payday_act]] Each payday is now its own test: a shortfall on one payday is not made up by a larger contribution for another, except through the early-contribution rule above.

Salary sacrifice follows the same timing. When an employee's pay is reduced so that a sacrificed contribution can be made, the reduction itself counts as a payment of qualifying earnings on that day, so the sacrificed amount and the employer's guarantee are both due within the same usual period.[[payday_act]]

sezioni.titolo: If a contribution is late or short
paragrafi: You owe the superannuation guarantee charge for that QE day. It is made up of the shortfall; a notional earnings component, worked out day by day over the late period at the general interest charge rate of the Taxation Administration Act 1953; an administrative uplift equal to 60% of the shortfall plus the notional earnings; and a choice loading if you did not follow the employee's choice of fund.[[payday_act]]
Regulations can reduce the administrative uplift, for example when you lodge a voluntary disclosure statement in the approved form before the ATO makes an assessment.[[payday_act]]

The Act repeals the definition of “approved clearing house” in the Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992.[[payday_act]] For what this means for the ATO's Small Business Superannuation Clearing House and for your payroll process, check the ATO's Payday Super page: ato.gov.au does not answer our checking server, so we do not summarise it here.[[ato_payday]]

esempio.titolo: Worked example: one fortnightly payday in July 2026
esempio.intro: This example applies only the rules in the Act. It assumes no public holiday covering a whole state or territory falls in the period; check the holiday calendars for your own dates.
righe: Qualifying earnings paid on Friday 3 July 2026 (the QE day)
Usual period: QE day to the 7th business day after (6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13 and 14 July)
fund must receive it by Tuesday 14 July 2026
New employee's first contribution: extended usual period, to the 20th business day after
Contribution received in full on Monday 13 July
Contribution never paid before the ATO assesses: shortfall
daily at the general interest charge rate over the late period
esempio.nota: So a single missed $360 contribution costs at least $576 ($360 + $216) plus notional earnings, compared with $360 paid on time.
